page.overview:
Who is Sixth Sense Devil?

The の|Dairokkan no Akuma}} is a Devil that embodies the concept of the sixth sense.

The Sixth Sense Devil's appearance is currently unknown.

The Sixth Sense Devil's personality is currently unknown.

At some point, prior to the events of Chainsaw Man, the Sixth Sense Devil was eaten by Pochita, thus ridding its existence along with the existence of the sixth sense from the world.
